picks.editorial_note: A $100M national program to expand AI compute access and build a skilled technical workforce is one of the largest single AI-research funding moves of the week, with reach across dozens of state and regional partners.
picks.title: New NSF State and Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs will power AI-enabled scientific research across the country

picks.editorial_note: NIST's formal MOU with the DOE Office of Science cements the White House-led Genesis Mission as federal policy, signaling a coordinated national push to embed AI in official science and standards work.
picks.title: NIST Joins National Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI Innovation

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope marks a genuine technical first for autonomous scientific instrumentation, backed by the Genesis Mission's Fermi Data Platform.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $50M investment in two Materials Innovation Platforms gives researchers nationwide access to autonomous AI-driven materials discovery equipment, a substantial infrastructure commitment.
picks.title: NSF stands up 2 Materials Innovation Platforms with $50M investment

picks.editorial_note: A $24.9M NSF grant to build a nationally accessible self-driving laboratory for metals discovery pairs significant funding with a novel shared-infrastructure model for materials science.
picks.title: Texas A&M to build self-driving laboratory for metals, open to researchers nationwide – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: Virginia Tech's $20M award to build a cloud-based, AI-enabled semiconductor lab strengthens a nationwide network of automated labs central to the federal Genesis Mission.
picks.title: University receives $20 million grant for cloud-based semiconductor lab
picks.university: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

picks.editorial_note: A $21.5M NSF AI Institute spanning Delaware, Delaware State, Princeton, and Penn (with UF joining) shows deep multi-institution coordination aimed at transforming rehabilitation and health care with human-AI collaboration.
picks.title: UF researchers join new NSF-funded AI institute to transform rehabilitation and health care

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's role leading a national Programmable Cloud Laboratory for advanced manufacturing extends the Genesis Mission's autonomous-experimentation infrastructure into materials and manufacturing research.
picks.title: Georgia Tech to Lead National Cloud Laboratory for Advanced Manufacturing and Materials

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's GSCo framework, letting generalist and specialist AI models collaborate on disease diagnosis, represents a meaningful architectural advance with direct clinical accuracy gains.
picks.title: HKUST Develops Novel AI Framework Enabling Efficient Collaboration between Generalist and Specialist Models for Disease Diagnosis
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: HKU's atomically thin analogue in-memory search chip offers a genuine hardware breakthrough that could bypass the von Neumann bottleneck limiting today's AI computing efficiency.
